recipes.name: Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Melt butter in a skillet, then cook chicken, carrots, celery, and onion for 8-10 minutes.
Stir in flour until no dry flour remains.
Slowly add broth and cream; cook until thick and bubbling.
Stir in peas and remove from heat. Let cool slightly.
Fit one crust into a pie plate, add filling, and top with the second crust.
Cut slits in the top and bake 30-35 minutes until golden.

recipes.name: Banana Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F and grease a loaf pan.
Mix mashed bananas with melted butter.
Stir in sugar, egg, and vanilla.
Sprinkle baking soda and salt over the mixture and stir in.
Add flour and mix until just combined.
Pour into the loaf pan and bake 55-60 minutes.
Cool before slicing.

recipes.name: Crock Pot Beef Stew
instructions: Toss beef with flour, salt, and pepper.
Add beef and all remaining ingredients to the crock pot.
Stir to combine.
Cover and cook on low for 8 hours (or high for 4-5 hours).
Stir before serving and adjust seasoning.

recipes.name: Macaroni and Cheese
instructions: Cook macaroni according to package directions and drain.
Melt butter in a pot, whisk in flour, and cook 1 minute.
Slowly whisk in milk and cook until thickened.
Stir in cheese, salt, and pepper until melted and smooth.
Add the macaroni and stir to coat.
Serve warm.

recipes.name: Taco Soup
ingredients: 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies
instructions: Brown the ground beef and onion in a large pot; drain excess fat.
Stir in taco seasoning.
Add beans, corn, tomatoes, tomato sauce, and broth (do not drain the cans).
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer 20 minutes.
Serve with your favorite toppings like cheese and sour cream.

recipes.name: Chicken Noodle Soup
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot and cook onion, carrots, and celery until soft.
Add garlic and cook 1 minute.
Pour in broth and bring to a boil.
Add noodles and cook until tender.
Stir in the chicken, salt, and pepper.
Simmer a few minutes and serve.

recipes.name: Meatloaf
ingredients: 1/4 cup ketchup, plus more for topping
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F.
Mix all ingredients together in a large bowl.
Press into a loaf pan or shape into a loaf on a baking sheet.
Spread extra ketchup on top.
Bake 55-60 minutes until cooked through.
Let rest 10 minutes before slicing.

recipes.name: Tater Tot Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F.
Brown ground beef and onion; drain.
Stir in soup, milk, salt, and pepper.
Spread the beef mixture in a baking dish.
Sprinkle with half the cheese, then top with tater tots.
Bake 40 minutes, add remaining cheese, and bake 5 more minutes.

recipes.name: Lasagna
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F and cook noodles.
Brown the beef and stir in marinara sauce.
Mix ricotta with egg and Italian seasoning.
Layer sauce, noodles, ricotta, and mozzarella in a baking dish; repeat.
Top with remaining mozzarella and parmesan.
Cover with foil and bake 25 minutes, then uncover and bake 20 more.
Let rest 10 minutes before serving.

recipes.name: Cinnamon Rolls
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm milk and let sit 5 minutes.
Mix in sugar, butter, egg, and flour to form a dough.
Knead, then let rise 1 hour until doubled.
Roll out, spread with butter, brown sugar, and cinnamon.
Roll up, slice, and place in a pan; let rise 30 minutes.
Bake at 350°F for 20-25 minutes.
Mix powdered sugar and cream cheese for icing and spread over warm rolls.

recipes.name: Chicken Alfredo
instructions: Cook fettuccine according to package directions.
Season and cook chicken until done, then slice.
Melt butter in a pan, add garlic, and cook 1 minute.
Stir in cream and bring to a simmer.
Whisk in parmesan until smooth; season with salt and pepper.
Toss pasta in the sauce and top with sliced chicken.

recipes.name: Instant Pot Pot Roast
instructions: Season the roast with salt and pepper.
Set Instant Pot to sauté and brown the roast on all sides in oil.
Add broth and Worcestershire sauce.
Add onion, carrots, and potatoes.
Seal and cook on high pressure for 60 minutes.
Let pressure release naturally for 15 minutes before opening.

recipes.name: Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F.
Cream butter with both sugars.
Beat in eggs and vanilla.
Mix in flour, baking soda, and salt.
Stir in chocolate chips.
Drop spoonfuls onto a baking sheet.
Bake 9-11 minutes until golden.

recipes.name: Biscuits and Gravy
instructions: Bake biscuits according to package directions.
Brown the sausage in a skillet, leaving the drippings.
Sprinkle flour over the sausage and stir 1-2 minutes.
Slowly add milk, stirring constantly.
Cook until thickened; season with salt and pepper.
Serve gravy over split biscuits.

recipes.name: Baked Ziti
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F and cook the ziti.
Brown the beef and stir in marinara sauce.
Mix cooked ziti with ricotta and half the sauce.
Spread in a baking dish and top with remaining sauce.
Sprinkle with mozzarella and parmesan.
Bake 25-30 minutes until bubbly and golden.
